title.zh: 卷7 帝紀第7 宣帝
title.raw: 卷7 帝紀第7 宣帝 Volume 7 Annals 7: Emperor Xuan

sentences.zh: 閏月乙亥，詔山東流民新復業者，及突厥侵掠家口破亡不能存濟者，竝給復一年。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, on yihai day, an edict granted one year of tax and corvée exemption to displaced persons east of the mountains who had newly returned to farming, and likewise to households destroyed and unable to survive after Turk raids.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, on yihai day, an edict granted one year of tax and corvée exemption to eastern refugees who had newly resumed farming, and likewise to households ruined by Turk raids and unable to support themselves.

sentences.zh: 立妃楊氏為皇后。

translations.literal: Consort Yang was established as empress.
translations.idiomatic: Consort Yang was installed as empress.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以上柱國趙王招為太師，陳王純為太傅，柱國代王達﹑滕王逌、盧國公尉遲運、薛國公長孫覽竝為上柱國。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, Superior Pillar-of-State Prince of Zhao Zhao was made grand preceptor; Prince of Chen Chun grand tutor; Pillar-of-State Prince of Dai Da, Prince of Teng You, Wei Chi Yun, Duke of Lu, and Changsun Lan, Duke of Xue, were all made superior pillars-of-state.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Superior Pillar-of-State Yuwen Zhao, Prince of Zhao, was made grand preceptor; Yuwen Chun, Prince of Chen, grand tutor; and Pillar-of-State Yuwen Da, Prince of Dai, Yuwen You, Prince of Teng, Wei Chi Yun, Duke of Lu, and Changsun Lan, Duke of Xue, were all made superior pillars-of-state.

sentences.zh: 進封柱國、平陽郡公王誼為揚國公。

translations.literal: Pillar-of-State Wang Yi, Duke of Pingyang Commandery, was advanced in rank to Duke of Yang.
translations.idiomatic: Pillar-of-State Wang Yi, Duke of Pingyang Commandery, was promoted to Duke of Yang.

sentences.zh: 是月，幽州人盧昌期據范陽反，詔柱國、東平公宇文神舉帥衆討平之。

translations.literal: That month, Lu Changqi of You Province seized Fan Yang and rebelled; an edict ordered Pillar-of-State Yuwen Shenju, Duke of Dongping, to lead troops to suppress and pacify him.
translations.idiomatic: That month Lu Changqi of You Province seized Fan Yang and rebelled; an edict ordered Pillar-of-State Yuwen Shenju, Duke of Dongping, to lead troops and put down the revolt.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛丑，月犯心前星。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on xinchou day, the moon encroached upon the star before the Heart.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, on xinchou day, the moon encroached upon the star before the Heart.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，祠太廟。

translations.literal: On yisi day sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestors' Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day he sacrificed at the Imperial Ancestors' Temple.

sentences.zh: 丙午，祠圓丘。

translations.literal: On bingwu day sacrifice was offered at the Round Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day he sacrificed at the Round Mound.

sentences.zh: 戊申，祠方丘。

translations.literal: On wushen day sacrifice was offered at the Square Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day he sacrificed at the Square Mound.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以小宗伯、岐國公斛斯徵為大宗伯。

translations.literal: On gengxu day Junior Director of Ceremonies Hesi Zheng, Duke of Qi, was made Grand Director of Ceremonies.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Junior Director of Ceremonies Hesi Zheng, Duke of Qi, was made grand director of ceremonies.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，熒惑、太白合於七星。

translations.literal: On bingchen day Mars and Venus conjoined at the Seven Stars.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Mars and Venus conjoined at the Seven Stars.

sentences.zh: 己未，太白犯軒轅大星。

translations.literal: On jiwei day Venus encroached upon the Great Star of Chariot-Pole.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day Venus encroached upon the Great Star of Chariot-Pole.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以柱國、南兗州總管、隨公楊堅為上柱國、大司馬。

translations.literal: On renxu day Pillar-of-State Yang Jian, Duke of Sui and inspector-general of Southern Yan, was made superior pillar-of-state and grand marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Pillar-of-State Yang Jian, Duke of Sui and inspector-general of Southern Yan, was made superior pillar-of-state and grand marshal.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，尊所生李氏為帝太后。

translations.literal: On guihai day his birth mother Lady Li was honored as empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day his birth mother Lady Li was honored as empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 八月丙寅，夕月於西郊。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on bingyin day, the evening moon sacrifice was performed at the western suburb.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, on bingyin day, the evening moon sacrifice was performed at the western suburb.

sentences.zh: 長安、萬年二縣民居在京城者，給復三年。

translations.literal: Residents of Chang'an and Wannian counties living within the capital were granted three years of tax and corvée exemption.
translations.idiomatic: Residents of Chang'an and Wannian counties living within the capital were granted three years of tax and corvée exemption.

sentences.zh: 壬申，行幸同州。

translations.literal: On renshen day he traveled to Tong Province.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day he traveled to Tong Province.

sentences.zh: 遣大使巡察諸州。

translations.literal: Grand envoys were dispatched to inspect the provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Grand envoys were dispatched to inspect the provinces.

sentences.zh: 詔制九條，宣下州郡：一曰，決獄科罪，皆准律文；

translations.literal: An edict established nine regulations and promulgated them to the provinces and commanderies: First, in deciding cases and imposing penalties, all must follow the law.
translations.idiomatic: An edict established nine regulations and sent them down to the provinces and commanderies: First, in deciding cases and imposing penalties, all must follow the statutes.

sentences.zh: 二曰，母族絕服外者，聽婚；

translations.literal: Second, marriage is permitted with relatives outside mourning on the maternal side when the maternal line is extinct.
translations.idiomatic: Second, when the maternal line is extinct, marriage is permitted with relatives outside the mourning grades on the mother's side.

sentences.zh: 三曰，以杖決罰，悉令依法；

translations.literal: Third, beatings as punishment must all follow the law.
translations.idiomatic: Third, all beatings as punishment must follow the law.

sentences.zh: 四曰，郡縣當境賊盜不擒獲者，竝仰錄奏；

translations.literal: Fourth, if bandits and robbers within a commandery or county's jurisdiction are not captured, all must be recorded and reported.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth, if bandits and robbers within a commandery or county's jurisdiction are not captured, all must be recorded and reported upward.

sentences.zh: 五曰，孝子順孫義夫節婦，表其門閭，才堪任用者，卽宜申薦；

translations.literal: Fifth, filial sons, obedient grandsons, righteous husbands, and chaste wives—honor their gates; if talent fits employment, they should immediately be recommended.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth, filial sons, obedient grandsons, righteous husbands, and chaste wives should have their households honored; if their talent fits employment, they should at once be recommended.

sentences.zh: 六曰，或昔經驅使，名位未達，或沉淪蓬蓽，文武可施，宜並採訪，具以名奏；

translations.literal: Sixth, some once served the state but name and rank did not reach fulfillment; some sank into humble stations yet civil and military talent can be applied—all should be sought out and reported by name.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth, some once served the state but never attained rank, and some sank into poverty though civil and military talent could still be used—all should be sought out and reported by name.

sentences.zh: 七曰，偽齊七品以上，已敕收用，八品以下，爰及流外，若欲入仕，皆聽預選，降二等授官；

translations.literal: Seventh, former Northern Qi officials of seventh rank and above already ordered to be employed; for eighth rank and below, including those outside the register, if they wish to enter service, all may pre-register and receive appointment two ranks lower.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh, former Northern Qi officials of seventh rank and above were already ordered to be employed; for eighth rank and below, including those outside the register, if they wish to enter service, all may pre-register and receive appointment two ranks lower.

sentences.zh: 八曰，州舉高才博學者為秀才，郡舉經明行修者為孝廉，上州、上郡歲一人，下州、下郡三歲一人；

translations.literal: Eighth, the province recommends the highly talented and broadly learned as xiucai; the commandery recommends those versed in the classics and upright in conduct as xiaolian; upper provinces and upper commanderies one per year, lower provinces and lower commanderies one every three years.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth, provinces should recommend the highly talented and broadly learned as xiucai; commanderies should recommend those versed in the classics and upright in conduct as xiaolian; upper provinces and upper commanderies one per year, lower provinces and lower commanderies one every three years.

sentences.zh: 九曰，年七十以上，依式授官，鰥寡困乏不能自存者，竝加稟恤。

translations.literal: Ninth, those aged seventy and above receive appointment according to regulation; widowers, widows, and those in hardship unable to support themselves all receive added grain relief.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth, those aged seventy and above receive appointment according to regulation; widowers, widows, and those in hardship who cannot support themselves all receive added grain relief.

sentences.zh: 以大司徒、杞國公亮為安州總管，上柱國、薛國公長孫覽為大司徒，柱國、揚國公王誼為大司空。

translations.literal: Grand Minister of the Masses Liang, Duke of Qi, was made inspector-general of An Province; Superior Pillar-of-State Changsun Lan, Duke of Xue, grand minister of the masses; Pillar-of-State Wang Yi, Duke of Yang, grand minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Minister of the Masses Liang, Duke of Qi, was made inspector-general of An Province; Superior Pillar-of-State Changsun Lan, Duke of Xue, was made grand minister of the masses; and Pillar-of-State Wang Yi, Duke of Yang, was made grand minister of works.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，太白入太微。

translations.literal: On gengchen day Venus entered the Supreme Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Venus entered the Supreme Palace.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以柱國、永昌公椿為大司寇。

translations.literal: On bingxu day Pillar-of-State Chun, Duke of Yongchang, was made grand minister of justice.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Pillar-of-State Yuwen Chun, Duke of Yongchang, was made grand minister of justice.

sentences.zh: 九月丁酉，熒惑入太微。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on dingyou day, Mars entered the Supreme Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, on dingyou day, Mars entered the Supreme Palace.

sentences.zh: 以柱國宇文盛、張掖公王傑、枹罕公辛威、鄖國公韋孝寬竝為上柱國。

translations.literal: Pillar-of-State Yuwen Sheng, Wang Jie, Duke of Zhangye, Xin Wei, Duke of Baoquan, and Wei Xiaokuan, Duke of Yun, were all made superior pillars-of-state.
translations.idiomatic: Pillar-of-State Yuwen Sheng, Wang Jie, Duke of Zhangye, Xin Wei, Duke of Baoquan, and Wei Xiaokuan, Duke of Yun, were all made superior pillars-of-state.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，封皇弟元為荊王。

translations.literal: On gengxu day the emperor's younger brother Yuan was enfeoffed as Prince of Jing.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day the emperor's younger brother Yuwen Yuan was enfeoffed as Prince of Jing.

sentences.zh: 詔諸應拜者，皆以三拜成禮。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that all who should perform obeisance use three bows to complete the rite.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that all who should perform obeisance complete the rite with three bows.

sentences.zh: 汾州稽胡帥劉受邏千舉兵反，詔上柱國、越王盛為行軍元帥，率衆討平之。

translations.literal: Liu Shouluoqian, leader of the Ji Hu in Fen Province, raised troops in rebellion; an edict ordered Superior Pillar-of-State Prince of Yue Sheng as campaign commander to lead troops to suppress and pacify him.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Shouluoqian, leader of the Ji Hu in Fen Province, raised troops in rebellion; an edict ordered Superior Pillar-of-State Yuwen Sheng, Prince of Yue, as campaign commander to lead troops and put down the revolt.

sentences.zh: 庚申，熒惑犯左執法。

translations.literal: On gengshen day Mars encroached upon the Left Law-Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Mars encroached upon the Left Law-Enforcer.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸酉，至自同州。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, on guiyou day, he returned from Tong Province.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month of winter, on guiyou day, he returned from Tong Province.

sentences.zh: 以大司空、揚國公王誼為襄州總管。

translations.literal: Grand Minister of Works Wang Yi, Duke of Yang, was made inspector-general of Xiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Minister of Works Wang Yi, Duke of Yang, was made inspector-general of Xiang Province.

sentences.zh: 戊子，百濟遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On wuzi day Baekje sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Baekje sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 十一月己亥，講武於道會苑，帝親擐甲冑。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on jihai day, a military review was held at Daohui Park; the emperor personally donned armor.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on jihai day, a military review was held at Daohui Park; Emperor Xuan personally donned armor.

sentences.zh: 是月，突厥寇邊，圍酒泉，殺掠吏民。

translations.literal: That month, the Turks raided the frontier, besieged Jiuquan, and killed and plundered officials and people.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Turks raided the frontier, besieged Jiuquan, and killed and plundered officials and people.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲子，以柱國、畢王賢為大司空。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on jiazi day, Pillar-of-State Prince of Bi Xian was made grand minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on jiazi day, Pillar-of-State Yuwen Xian, Prince of Bi, was made grand minister of works.

sentences.zh: 癸未，熒惑入氐，仍留經一月。

translations.literal: On guiwei day Mars entered the Base asterism and remained there for a full month.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day Mars entered the Base asterism and remained there for a full month.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以上柱國、河陽總管滕王逌為行軍元帥，率衆伐陳。

translations.literal: On jichou day Superior Pillar-of-State Prince of Teng You, inspector-general of Heyang, was made campaign commander to lead troops against Chen.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Superior Pillar-of-State Yuwen You, Prince of Teng and inspector-general of Heyang, was made campaign commander to lead troops against Chen.

sentences.zh: 免京師見徒，竝令從軍。

translations.literal: Prisoners visible in the capital were pardoned and all ordered to join the army.
translations.idiomatic: Prisoners held in the capital were pardoned and all ordered to join the army.

sentences.zh: 二月癸亥，詔曰：

translations.literal: Second month, on guihai day, an edict said:
translations.idiomatic: Second month, on guihai day, an edict said:

sentences.zh: 河洛之地，世稱朝市。

translations.literal: The lands of the Yellow and Luo rivers are called the court and market of the age.
translations.idiomatic: The lands of the Yellow and Luo rivers are called the court and market of the age.

sentences.zh: 上則於天，陰陽所會；

translations.literal: Above they align with Heaven, the meeting place of yin and yang;
translations.idiomatic: Above they align with Heaven, the meeting place of yin and yang;

sentences.zh: 下紀於地，職貢路均。

translations.literal: below they are marked on earth, where tribute routes are equal.
translations.idiomatic: below they are marked on earth, where tribute routes converge.

sentences.zh: 聖人以萬物阜安，乃建王國。

translations.literal: The sage, that the myriad things be abundant and secure, thereupon established royal states.
translations.idiomatic: The sage, that the myriad things be abundant and secure, thereupon established royal states.

sentences.zh: 時經五代，世歷千祀，規模弘遠，邑居壯麗。

translations.literal: Through five dynasties and a thousand ages, its scale was vast and its dwellings majestic.
translations.idiomatic: Through five dynasties and a thousand reigns, its scale was vast and its dwellings majestic.

sentences.zh: 自魏氏失馭，城闕為墟，君子有戀舊之風，小人深懷土之思。

translations.literal: Since the Wei house lost control, walls and gates became ruins; gentlemen had a longing for the old, common folk deeply yearned for their native soil.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Wei house lost control, walls and gates became ruins; gentlemen longed for the old order, and common folk deeply yearned for their native soil.

sentences.zh: 我太祖受命酆鎬，胥宇崤函，蕩定四方，有懷光宅。

translations.literal: Our Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai received the mandate at Feng and Hao, set his capital at Xiaohan, pacified the four quarters, and cherished the ambition of Glorious Dwelling.
translations.idiomatic: Our Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai received the mandate at Feng and Hao, set his capital at Xiaohan, pacified the four quarters, and cherished the ambition of Glorious Dwelling.

sentences.zh: 高祖神功聖略，混一區宇，往巡東夏，省方觀俗，布政此宮，遂移氣序。

translations.literal: The late Emperor Wu Yuwen Yong, with divine achievement and sage strategy, unified the realm; he went east to the eastern lands, inspected the regions and observed customs, and issued government from this palace, thereby shifting the seasonal order.
translations.idiomatic: The late Emperor Wu Yuwen Yong, with divine achievement and sage strategy, unified the realm; he toured the eastern lands, inspected the regions and observed customs, and issued government from this palace, thereby shifting the seasonal order.

sentences.zh: 朕以眇身，祗承寶祚，庶幾聿修之志，敢忘燕翼之心。

translations.literal: I, with my slight person, reverently received the precious succession; I look to continue the work of restoration and dare not forget the heart of nurturing those who come after.
translations.idiomatic: I, with my slight person, reverently received the precious succession; I look to continue the work of restoration and dare not forget the duty of nurturing those who come after.

sentences.zh: 一昨駐蹕金墉，備嘗遊覽，百王制度，基趾尚存，今若因修，為功易立。

translations.literal: Yesterday I halted at the Golden Walled city, fully toured it; the institutions of the hundred kings, foundations and corners still remain—if we now repair upon them, the achievement is easy to establish.
translations.idiomatic: Yesterday I halted at the Golden Walled city and toured it in full; the institutions of the hundred kings, foundations and corners still remain—if we now repair upon them, the work will be easy to complete.

sentences.zh: 宜命邦事，修復舊都。

translations.literal: It is fitting to charge the state with affairs and restore the former capital.
translations.idiomatic: It is fitting to charge the state with affairs and restore the former capital.

sentences.zh: 奢儉取文質之間，功役依子來之義。

translations.literal: Extravagance and frugality should be taken at the mean between ornament and substance; labor and corvée should follow the principle of the people coming willingly.
translations.idiomatic: Extravagance and frugality should be taken at the mean between ornament and substance; labor and corvée should follow the principle of willing popular service.

sentences.zh: 北瞻河內，咫尺非遙，前詔經營，今宜停罷。

translations.literal: Looking north to Henei, a short distance and not far; the former edict on construction should now be halted.
translations.idiomatic: Looking north to Henei, a short distance and not far; the former edict on construction should now be halted.

sentences.zh: 於是發山東諸州兵，增一月功為四十五日役，起洛陽宮。

translations.literal: Thereupon troops from the eastern provinces were mobilized, one month's corvée increased to forty-five days of service, and Luoyang palace was begun.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon troops from the eastern provinces were mobilized, one month's corvée was increased to forty-five days of service, and construction of the Luoyang palace was begun.

sentences.zh: 常役四萬人，以迄于晏駕。

translations.literal: Permanently forty thousand corvée workers, continuing until the emperor's death.
translations.idiomatic: Forty thousand corvée workers were permanently assigned, continuing until the emperor's death.

sentences.zh: 幷移相州六府於洛陽，稱東京六府。

translations.literal: The six offices of Xiang Province were also moved to Luoyang, called the Eastern Capital Six Offices.
translations.idiomatic: The six offices of Xiang Province were also moved to Luoyang and called the Eastern Capital Six Offices.

sentences.zh: 殺柱國、徐州總管、郯國公王軌。

translations.literal: Pillar-of-State Wang Gui, Duke of Tan, inspector-general of Xu Province, was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Pillar-of-State Wang Gui, Duke of Tan and inspector-general of Xu Province, was executed.

sentences.zh: 停南討諸軍。

translations.literal: The southern expedition armies were halted.
translations.idiomatic: The southern expedition armies were halted.

sentences.zh: 以趙王招女為千金公主，嫁於突厥。

translations.literal: Prince of Zhao Zhao's daughter was made Princess Qianjin and married to the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Zhao, Prince of Zhao, had his daughter made Princess Qianjin and married her to the Turks.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以上柱國、鄖國公韋孝寬為徐州總管。

translations.literal: On wuchen day Superior Pillar-of-State Wei Xiaokuan, Duke of Yun, was made inspector-general of Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Superior Pillar-of-State Wei Xiaokuan, Duke of Yun, was made inspector-general of Xu Province.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，行幸鄴。

translations.literal: On yihai day he traveled to Ye.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day he traveled to Ye.

sentences.zh: 丙子，初令授總管刺史及行兵者，加持節，餘悉罷之。

translations.literal: On bingzi day it was first ordered that inspector-generals, provincial governors, and those leading troops receive the holding-seal; all others were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day it was first ordered that inspector-generals, provincial governors, and those leading troops receive the holding-seal; all others were abolished.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔曰：

translations.literal: On xinsi day an edict said:
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day an edict said:

sentences.zh: 有聖大寶，實惟重器，玄天表命，人事與能，幽顯同謀，確乎不易。

translations.literal: The sage's great treasure is truly the weighty vessel; the dark Heaven displays the mandate, human affairs accord with capacity; the hidden and manifest share one plan—firm and unchanging.
translations.idiomatic: The sage's great treasure is truly the weighty vessel; dark Heaven displays the mandate, human affairs accord with capacity; the hidden and manifest share one plan—firm and unchanging.

sentences.zh: 域中之大，實懸定於杳冥；

translations.literal: Greatness within the realm is truly suspended in the obscure;
translations.idiomatic: Greatness within the realm is truly suspended in the obscure;

sentences.zh: 天下為公，蓋不避於內舉。

translations.literal: All under Heaven is public—surely one does not avoid promoting from within.
translations.idiomatic: All under Heaven is public—surely one does not avoid promoting from within.

sentences.zh: 我大周感蒼昊之精，受河洛之錫，武功文德，光格區宇，創業垂統，永光無窮。

translations.literal: Our Great Zhou received the essence of the azure Heaven, received the gift of the He and Luo; martial achievement and civil virtue shine through the realm, founding the enterprise and bequeathing the lineage, glory without end.
translations.idiomatic: Our Great Zhou received the essence of azure Heaven and the gift of the He and Luo; martial achievement and civil virtue shine through the realm, founding the enterprise and bequeathing the lineage, with glory without end.

sentences.zh: 朕以寡薄，祗承鴻緒，上賴先朝得一之跡，下藉羣后不貳之心。

translations.literal: I, being paltry and thin, reverently received the great succession; above I rely on the former court's achievement of unified rule, below I rely on the lords' undivided hearts.
translations.idiomatic: I, being paltry and thin, reverently received the great succession; above I rely on the former court's achievement of unified rule, below I rely on the lords' undivided hearts.

sentences.zh: 職貢與雲雨俱通，憲章共光華竝亙。

translations.literal: Tribute routes open like clouds and rain together; statutes and ordinances share radiance and extension.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute routes open like clouds and rain together; statutes and ordinances share radiance and extension.

sentences.zh: 圓首方足，咸登仁壽，思隆國本，用弘天曆。

translations.literal: All who have round heads and square feet ascend to benevolent longevity; thinking to exalt the state's foundation, thereby extending Heaven's calendar.
translations.idiomatic: All who have round heads and square feet ascend to benevolent longevity; thinking to exalt the state's foundation, thereby extending Heaven's calendar.

sentences.zh: 皇太子衍，地居上嗣，正統所歸。

translations.literal: Crown Prince Yan occupies the position of eldest successor; the legitimate succession returns to him.
translations.idiomatic: Crown Prince Yuwen Yan occupies the position of eldest successor; the legitimate succession returns to him.

sentences.zh: 遠憑積德之休，允協無疆之祚。

translations.literal: Far relying on accumulated virtue's blessing, he truly accords with boundless fortune.
translations.idiomatic: Far relying on accumulated virtue's blessing, he truly accords with boundless fortune.

sentences.zh: 帝王之量，未肅而成；

translations.literal: A ruler's measure, not yet solemnized but already fulfilled;
translations.idiomatic: A ruler's measure, not yet solemnized but already fulfilled;

sentences.zh: 天祿之期，不謀已至。

translations.literal: Heaven's stipend's term, without scheming already arrived.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's stipend's term, without scheming already arrived.

sentences.zh: 朕今傳位於衍。

translations.literal: I now transmit the throne to Yan.
translations.idiomatic: I now transmit the throne to Yuwen Yan.

sentences.zh: 乃睠四海，深合謳歌之望；

translations.literal: Thus cherishing the four seas, deeply fitting the hope of songs of praise;
translations.idiomatic: Thus cherishing the four seas, deeply fitting the hope of songs of praise;

sentences.zh: 俾予一人，高蹈風塵之表。

translations.literal: letting me alone walk high above the dust of the world.
translations.idiomatic: letting me alone walk high above the dust of the world.

sentences.zh: 萬方兆庶，知朕意焉。

translations.literal: Let the myriad regions and masses know my intent.
translations.idiomatic: Let the myriad regions and masses know my intent.

sentences.zh: 可大赦天下，改大成元年為大象元年。

translations.literal: A great amnesty is proclaimed for all under Heaven; Dacheng year 1 is changed to Daxiang year 1.
translations.idiomatic: A great amnesty is proclaimed for all under Heaven; Dacheng year 1 is changed to Daxiang year 1.

sentences.zh: 帝於是自稱天元皇帝，所居稱天臺，冕有二十四旒，

translations.literal: The emperor thereupon styled himself Tianyuan Emperor; his residence was called Celestial Terrace; his crown had twenty-four tassels,
translations.idiomatic: The emperor thereupon styled himself Tianyuan Emperor; his residence was called Celestial Terrace; his crown had twenty-four tassels,

translations.literal: (Chamber)
translations.idiomatic: (Chamber)

sentences.zh: 〔車〕服旗鼓，皆以二十四為節。

translations.literal: [Carriage] robes, banners and flags—all used twenty-four as the measure.
translations.idiomatic: [Carriage] robes, banners and flags—all used twenty-four as the measure.

sentences.zh: 內史、御正皆置上大夫。

translations.literal: The Inner Scribe and Central Rectifier offices each had a senior grandee appointed.
translations.idiomatic: The Inner Scribe and Central Rectifier offices each had a senior grandee appointed.

sentences.zh: 皇帝衍稱正陽宮，置納言、御正、諸衛等官，皆准天臺。

translations.literal: Emperor Yan styled his residence Zhengyang Palace; Nayan, Central Rectifier, Guard, and other offices were all modeled on the Celestial Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Yuwen Yan styled his residence Zhengyang Palace; Nayan, Central Rectifier, Guard, and other offices were all modeled on the Celestial Terrace.

sentences.zh: 尊皇太后為天元皇太后。

translations.literal: The empress dowager was honored as Tianyuan Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager was honored as Tianyuan Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 封內史上大夫鄭譯為沛國公。

translations.literal: Zheng Yi, senior grandee and Inner Scribe, was enfeoffed as Duke of Pei.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Yi, senior grandee and Inner Scribe, was enfeoffed as Duke of Pei.

sentences.zh: 癸未，日初出及將入時，其中並有烏色，大如雞卵，經四日滅。

translations.literal: On guiwei day, at the sun's first rising and as it was about to set, within it were both dark spots as large as a chicken egg, persisting four days before vanishing.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, at the sun's first rising and as it was about to set, both showed dark spots as large as a chicken egg, persisting four days before vanishing.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以上柱國大前疑越王盛為太保，大右弼蜀公尉遲迥為大前疑，代王達為大右弼。

translations.literal: On wuzi day Superior Pillar-of-State Yuwen Sheng, Grand Left Mentor and Prince of Yue, was made Grand Guardian; Yuchi Jiong, Duke of Shu and Grand Right Assistant, was made Grand Left Mentor; and Prince of Dai Da was made Grand Right Assistant.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Superior Pillar-of-State Yuwen Sheng, Grand Left Mentor and Prince of Yue, was made grand guardian; Yuchi Jiong, Duke of Shu and grand right assistant, was made grand left mentor; and Yuwen Da, Prince of Dai, was made grand right assistant.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔徙鄴城石經於洛陽。

translations.literal: On xinmao day an edict ordered the Ye city stone classics moved to Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day an edict ordered the Ye city stone classics moved to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 又詔曰：「洛陽舊都，今旣修復，凡是元遷之戶，並聽還洛州。

translations.literal: Another edict said: "The old capital Luoyang, now that it has been restored, all households originally relocated may return to Luo Province.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict said: "The old capital Luoyang, now that it has been restored, all households originally relocated may return to Luo Province.

sentences.zh: 此外諸民欲往者，亦任其意。

translations.literal: Other people who wish to go may likewise follow their intent.
translations.idiomatic: Other people who wish to go may likewise follow their intent.

sentences.zh: 河陽、幽、相、豫、亳、青、徐七總管，受東京六府處分。」

translations.literal: The seven inspector-generals of Heyang, You, Xiang, Yu, Bo, Qing, and Xu shall take orders from the Eastern Capital Six Offices."
translations.idiomatic: The seven inspector-generals of Heyang, You, Xiang, Yu, Bo, Qing, and Xu shall take orders from the Eastern Capital Six Offices."

sentences.zh: 三月壬寅，以上柱國、薛國公長孫覽為涇州總管。

translations.literal: Third month, on renyin day, Superior Pillar-of-State Changsun Lan, Duke of Xue, was made inspector-general of Jing Province.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, on renyin day, Superior Pillar-of-State Changsun Lan, Duke of Xue, was made inspector-general of Jing Province.

sentences.zh: 庚申，至自東巡，大陳軍伍，帝親擐甲冑，入自青門。

translations.literal: On gengshen day he returned from the eastern tour; the armies were arrayed in great formation; the emperor personally donned armor and entered through the Blue Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day he returned from the eastern tour; the armies were arrayed in great formation; Emperor Xuan personally donned armor and entered through the Blue Gate.

sentences.zh: 皇帝衍備法駕從入。

translations.literal: Emperor Yan prepared the full imperial procession and entered with it.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuan prepared the full imperial procession and entered with it.

sentences.zh: 百官迎於青門外。

translations.literal: All officials welcomed him outside the Azure Gate.
translations.idiomatic: All officials welcomed him outside the Azure Gate.

sentences.zh: 其時驟雨，儀衛失容。

translations.literal: At that time a sudden downpour fell and the guard of honor lost formation.
translations.idiomatic: At that time a sudden downpour fell and the guard of honor lost formation.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，封趙王招第二子貫為永康縣王。

translations.literal: On xinyou day Prince Zhao Zhao's second son Guan was enfeoffed as Prince of Yongkang county.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Prince Zhao Zhao's second son Guan was enfeoffed as Prince of Yongkang county.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬戌朔，有司奏言日蝕，不視事。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, first day renxu, the responsible offices reported a solar eclipse and that court business would be suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, on the first day, renxu, the responsible offices reported a solar eclipse and that court business would be suspended.

sentences.zh: 過時不食，乃臨軒。

translations.literal: When the eclipse hour had passed without eating, he then held audience at the front hall.
translations.idiomatic: When the eclipse hour had passed without eating, he then held audience at the front hall.

sentences.zh: 立妃朱氏為天元帝后。

translations.literal: Consort Zhu was installed as empress of the Heavenly Primordial Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Consort Zhu was installed as empress of the Heavenly Primordial Emperor.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以柱國、畢王賢為上柱國。

translations.literal: On guihai day Pillar-of-State Prince Bi Xian was made Grand Pillar-of-State.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Pillar-of-State Prince Bi Xian was made Grand Pillar-of-State.

sentences.zh: 己巳，祠太廟。

translations.literal: On jisi day sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestors' Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day he sacrificed at the Imperial Ancestors' Temple.

sentences.zh: 壬午，大醮於正武殿。

translations.literal: On renwu day a great rite was held at the Hall of Correct Martialness.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day a great rite was held at the Hall of Correct Martialness.

sentences.zh: 戊子，太白、歲星、辰星合於東井。

translations.literal: On wuzi day Venus, Jupiter, and Mercury conjoined in the Well.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Venus, Jupiter, and Mercury conjoined in the Well.

sentences.zh: 五月辛亥，以洺州襄國郡為趙國，以齊州濟南郡為陳國，以豐州武當、安富二郡為越國，以潞州上黨郡為代國，以荊州新野郡為滕國，邑各一萬戶。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on xinhai day, Xiangguo commandery of Ming Province was made the Zhao state, Jinan commandery of Qi Province the Chen state, Wudang and Anfu commanderies of Feng Province the Yue state, Shangdang commandery of Lu Province the Dai state, and Xinye commandery of Jing Province the Teng state, each with ten thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, on xinhai day, Xiangguo commandery of Ming Province was made the Zhao state, Jinan commandery of Qi Province the Chen state, Wudang and Anfu commanderies of Feng Province the Yue state, Shangdang commandery of Lu Province the Dai state, and Xinye commandery of Jing Province the Teng state, each with ten thousand households.

sentences.zh: 令趙王招、陳王純、越王盛、代王達、滕王逌竝之國。

translations.literal: Prince Zhao Zhao, Prince Chen Chun, Prince Yue Sheng, Prince Dai Da, and Prince Teng You were all sent to their states.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Zhao Zhao, Prince Chen Chun, Prince Yue Sheng, Prince Dai Da, and Prince Teng You were all sent to their states.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，有流星大如鬥，出太微，落落如遺火。

translations.literal: On guichou day a meteor as large as a dipper emerged from Supreme Palace Enclosure and trailed down like scattered embers.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day a meteor as large as a dipper emerged from Supreme Palace Enclosure and trailed down like scattered embers.

sentences.zh: 是月，遣使簡視京兆及諸州士民之女，充選後宮。

translations.literal: That month, envoys were sent to select daughters of gentry and commoners in Jingzhao and the various provinces to fill the inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: That month, envoys were sent to select daughters of gentry and commoners in Jingzhao and the various provinces to fill the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 突厥寇幷州。

translations.literal: The Turks raided Bing Province.
translations.idiomatic: The Turks raided Bing Province.

sentences.zh: 六月丁卯，有流星大如雞子，出氐，西北流，長一丈，入月中。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on dingmao day, a meteor as large as a chicken egg emerged from the Root, flowed northwest for a length of one zhang, and entered the moon.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, on dingmao day, a meteor as large as a chicken egg emerged from the Root, flowed northwest for a length of one zhang, and entered the moon.

sentences.zh: 己巳，月犯房北頭第二星。

translations.literal: On jisi day the moon encroached upon the second star at the northern head of the Room.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day the moon encroached upon the second star at the northern head of the Room.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，有流星大如鬥，出營室，流入東壁。

translations.literal: On yiyou day a meteor as large as a dipper emerged from Encampment and flowed into the eastern Wall.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day a meteor as large as a dipper emerged from Encampment and flowed into the eastern Wall.

sentences.zh: 是月，咸陽有池水變為血。

translations.literal: That month, pool water at Xianyang turned to blood.
translations.idiomatic: That month, pool water at Xianyang turned to blood.

sentences.zh: 發山東諸州民，修長城。

translations.literal: The people of the eastern provinces were mobilized to repair the Long Wall.
translations.idiomatic: The people of the eastern provinces were mobilized to repair the Long Wall.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚寅，以大司空、畢王賢為雍州牧，大後丞、隨國公楊堅為大前疑，柱國、滎陽公司馬消難為大後丞。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on gengyin day, Grand Minister of Works Prince Bi Xian was made governor of Yong Province, Grand Rear Chancellor Duke of Sui Yang Jian was made Grand Front Advisor, and Pillar-of-State Duke of Xingyang Sima Xiaonan was made Grand Rear Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, on gengyin day, Grand Minister of Works Prince Bi Xian was made governor of Yong Province, Grand Rear Chancellor Yang Jian, Duke of Sui, was made Grand Front Advisor, and Pillar-of-State Sima Xiaonan, Duke of Xingyang, was made Grand Rear Chancellor.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，熒惑掩房北頭第一星。

translations.literal: On renchen day Mars masked the first star at the northern head of the Room.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Mars masked the first star at the northern head of the Room.

sentences.zh: 丙申，納大後丞司馬消難女為正陽宮皇后。

translations.literal: On bingshen day the daughter of Grand Rear Chancellor Sima Xiaonan was taken in as empress of the Zhengyang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day the daughter of Grand Rear Chancellor Sima Xiaonan was taken in as empress of the Zhengyang Palace.

sentences.zh: 尊天元帝太后李氏為天皇太后。

translations.literal: The Heavenly Primordial Emperor's dowager empress Lady Li was honored as Grand Heavenly Dowager Empress.
translations.idiomatic: The Heavenly Primordial Emperor's dowager empress Lady Li was honored as Grand Heavenly Dowager Empress.

sentences.zh: 壬子，改天元帝后朱氏為天皇後。

translations.literal: On renzi day Empress Zhu of the Heavenly Primordial Emperor was retitled Grand Heavenly Empress.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Empress Zhu of the Heavenly Primordial Emperor was retitled Grand Heavenly Empress.

sentences.zh: 立妃元氏為天右皇后，妃陳氏為天左皇后。

translations.literal: Consort Yuan was installed as Heavenly Right Empress and Consort Chen as Heavenly Left Empress.
translations.idiomatic: Consort Yuan was installed as Heavenly Right Empress and Consort Chen as Heavenly Left Empress.

sentences.zh: 八月庚申，行幸同州。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on gengshen day, he traveled to Tong Province.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, on gengshen day, he traveled to Tong Province.

sentences.zh: 壬申，還宮。

translations.literal: On renshen day he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以天左皇后父大將軍陳山提、天右皇后父開府元晟竝為上柱國。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day General Chen Shanti, father of the Heavenly Left Empress, and Opening-the-Feudatory Yuan Sheng, father of the Heavenly Right Empress, were both made Grand Pillar-of-State.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day General Chen Shanti, father of the Heavenly Left Empress, and Opening-the-Feudatory Yuan Sheng, father of the Heavenly Right Empress, were both made Grand Pillar-of-State.

sentences.zh: 山提封鄅國公，晟封翼國公。

translations.literal: Shanti was enfeoffed Duke of Yu and Sheng Duke of Yi.
translations.idiomatic: Shanti was enfeoffed Duke of Yu and Sheng Duke of Yi.

sentences.zh: 開府楊雄為邗國公，乙弗寔戴國公。

translations.literal: Opening-the-Feudatory Yang Xiong was made Duke of Han and Yifu Shi Duke of Dai.
translations.idiomatic: Opening-the-Feudatory Yang Xiong was made Duke of Han and Yifu Shi Duke of Dai.

sentences.zh: 初，高祖作《刑書要制》，用法嚴重。

translations.literal: At first, High Ancestor had drawn up the Essentials of Punishment Law, applying the law with severity.
translations.idiomatic: At first, High Ancestor had drawn up the Essentials of Punishment Law, applying the law with severity.

sentences.zh: 及帝卽位，以海內初平，恐物情未附，乃除之。

translations.literal: When the emperor took the throne, because the realm had only just been pacified and he feared hearts were not yet won, he abolished it.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xuan took the throne, because the realm had only just been pacified and he feared hearts were not yet won, he abolished it.

sentences.zh: 至是大醮於正武殿，告天而行焉。

translations.literal: By this time a great rite was held at the Hall of Correct Martialness and proclaimed to Heaven before being put into effect.
translations.idiomatic: By this time a great rite was held at the Hall of Correct Martialness and proclaimed to Heaven before being put into effect.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，熒惑犯南斗第五星。

translations.literal: On xinsi day Mars encroached upon the fifth star of the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Mars encroached upon the fifth star of the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以上柱國、雍州牧、畢王賢為太師，上柱國、郇國公韓建業為大左輔。

translations.literal: On renwu day Grand Pillar-of-State and Yong Province governor Prince Bi Xian was made Grand Preceptor, and Grand Pillar-of-State Han Jianye, Duke of Xun, was made Grand Left Assistant.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Grand Pillar-of-State and Yong Province governor Prince Bi Xian was made Grand Preceptor, and Grand Pillar-of-State Han Jianye, Duke of Xun, was made Grand Left Assistant.

sentences.zh: 是月，所在有蟻羣鬬，各方四五尺，死者什八九。

translations.literal: That month, in various places ant colonies fought one another in masses four or five chi square; eight or nine tenths of them died.
translations.idiomatic: That month, in various places ant colonies fought one another in masses four or five chi square; eight or nine tenths of them died.

sentences.zh: 九月己酉，太白入南斗。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on jiyou day Venus entered the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, on jiyou day Venus entered the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以酆王貞為大冢宰。

translations.literal: On yimao day Prince Feng Zhen was made Grand Steward.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Prince Feng Zhen was made Grand Steward.

sentences.zh: 上柱國、鄖國公韋孝寬為行軍元帥，率行軍總管杞國公亮、郕國公梁士彥以伐陳。

translations.literal: Grand Pillar-of-State Wei Xiaokuan, Duke of Yun, was made campaigning marshal and led campaigning commanders-in-chief Duke of Qi Yu Liang and Duke of Cheng Liang Shiyan against Chen.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Pillar-of-State Wei Xiaokuan, Duke of Yun, was made campaigning marshal and led campaigning commanders-in-chief Yu Liang, Duke of Qi, and Liang Shiyan, Duke of Cheng, against Chen.

sentences.zh: 遣御正杜杲、禮部薛舒使於陳。

translations.literal: Director of Correctness Du Guo and the Ministry of Rites' Xue Shu were sent as envoys to Chen.
translations.idiomatic: Director of Correctness Du Guo and the Ministry of Rites' Xue Shu were sent as envoys to Chen.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬戌，歲星犯軒轅大星。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, on renxu day Jupiter encroached upon the great star of the Chariot Handle.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month of winter, on renxu day Jupiter encroached upon the great star of the Chariot Handle.

sentences.zh: 是日，帝幸道會苑大醮，以高祖武皇帝配。

translations.literal: That day the emperor visited Dao Assembly Park for a great rite, with High Ancestor Emperor Wu as associate spirit.
translations.idiomatic: That day the emperor visited Dao Assembly Park for a great rite, with High Ancestor Emperor Wu as associate spirit.

sentences.zh: 醮訖，論議於行殿。

translations.literal: When the rite concluded, deliberations were held in the traveling hall.
translations.idiomatic: When the rite concluded, deliberations were held in the traveling hall.

sentences.zh: 是歲，初復佛像及天尊像。

translations.literal: That year Buddhist images and images of the Heavenly Worthy were first restored.
translations.idiomatic: That year Buddhist images and images of the Heavenly Worthy were first restored.

sentences.zh: 至是，帝與二像俱南面而坐，大陳雜戲，令京城士民縱觀。

translations.literal: By this time the emperor sat facing south together with both images, displayed a great array of mixed entertainments, and allowed the gentry and people of the capital to watch freely.
translations.idiomatic: By this time the emperor sat facing south together with both images, displayed a great array of mixed entertainments, and allowed the gentry and people of the capital to watch freely.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，熒惑、鎮星合於虛。

translations.literal: On yiyou day Mars and Saturn conjoined in Emptiness.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Mars and Saturn conjoined in Emptiness.

sentences.zh: 是月，相州人段德舉謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: That month Duan Deju of Xiang Province plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: That month Duan Deju of Xiang Province plotted rebellion and was executed.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙未，幸溫湯。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on yiwei day, he visited the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on yiwei day, he visited the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，行幸同州。

translations.literal: On wuxu day he traveled to Tong Province.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day he traveled to Tong Province.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，還宮。

translations.literal: On renyin day he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 己酉，有星大如斗，出張，東南流，光明燭地。

translations.literal: On jiyou day a star as large as a dipper emerged from the Spread and flowed southeast, its brightness illuminating the ground.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day a star as large as a dipper emerged from the Spread and flowed southeast, its brightness illuminating the ground.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，初鑄永通萬國錢，以一當十，與五行大布竝行。

translations.literal: On dingsi day the Everlasting Circulation Ten Thousand States coin was first cast, valued at ten, and circulated together with the Five Elements Large Cloth coin.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day the Everlasting Circulation Ten Thousand States coin was first cast, valued at ten, and circulated together with the Five Elements Large Cloth coin.

sentences.zh: 是月，韋孝寬拔壽陽，杞國公亮拔黃城，梁士彥拔廣陵。

translations.literal: That month Wei Xiaokuan captured Shouyang, Duke of Qi Yu Liang captured Huangcheng, and Liang Shiyan captured Guangling.
translations.idiomatic: That month Wei Xiaokuan captured Shouyang, Yu Liang, Duke of Qi, captured Huangcheng, and Liang Shiyan captured Guangling.

sentences.zh: 陳人退走。

translations.literal: The Chen forces retreated.
translations.idiomatic: The Chen forces retreated.

sentences.zh: 於是江北盡平。

translations.literal: Thereupon the entire north of the Yangzi was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the entire north of the Yangzi was pacified.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊午，以災異屢見，帝御路寢，見百官。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on wuwu day, because portents and anomalies had repeatedly appeared, the emperor held audience at the Road Hall and received the hundred officials.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on wuwu day, because portents and anomalies had repeatedly appeared, the emperor held audience at the Road Hall and received the hundred officials.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：

translations.literal: An edict declared:
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared:

sentences.zh: 穹昊在上，聰明自下，吉凶由人，妖不自作。

translations.literal: "The vaulted Heaven is above; understanding comes from below. Fortune and calamity depend on men; portents do not arise of themselves.
translations.idiomatic: "The vaulted Heaven is above; understanding comes from below. Fortune and calamity depend on men; portents do not arise of themselves.

sentences.zh: 朕以寡德，君臨區宇，大道未行，小信非福。

translations.literal: I am of meager virtue yet rule the realm; the Great Way has not been practiced, and petty reliance on omens is not a blessing.
translations.idiomatic: I am of meager virtue yet rule the realm; the Great Way has not been practiced, and petty reliance on omens is not a blessing.

sentences.zh: 始於秋季，及此玄冬，幽顯殷勤，屢貽深戒。

translations.literal: From autumn until this deep winter, both seen and unseen have been earnest and have repeatedly sent severe warnings.
translations.idiomatic: From autumn until this deep winter, both seen and unseen have been earnest and have repeatedly sent severe warnings.

sentences.zh: 至有金入南斗，木犯軒轅，熒惑干房，又與土合，流星照夜，東南而下。

translations.literal: There were Venus entering the Southern Dipper, Jupiter encroaching on the Chariot Handle, Mars interfering with the Room, then conjoining with Saturn; meteors lit the night flowing southeast.
translations.idiomatic: There were Venus entering the Southern Dipper, Jupiter encroaching on the Chariot Handle, Mars interfering with the Room, then conjoining with Saturn; meteors lit the night flowing southeast.

sentences.zh: 然則南斗主於爵祿，軒轅為於後宮，房曰明堂，布政所也，火土則憂孽之兆，流星乃兵凶之驗。

translations.literal: Now the Southern Dipper governs rank and stipend; the Chariot Handle pertains to the inner palace; the Room is called the Bright Hall, the seat of government; fire and earth together are omens of calamity and disorder; meteors are signs of military disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Now the Southern Dipper governs rank and stipend; the Chariot Handle pertains to the inner palace; the Room is called the Bright Hall, the seat of government; fire and earth together are omens of calamity and disorder; meteors are signs of military disaster.

sentences.zh: 豈其官人失序，女謁尚行，政事乘方，憂患將至？

translations.literal: Could it be that officials are out of order, women still meddle in affairs, government runs contrary to the norm, and trouble is about to come?
translations.idiomatic: Could it be that officials are out of order, women still meddle in affairs, government runs contrary to the norm, and trouble is about to come?

sentences.zh: 何其昭著，若斯之甚。

translations.literal: How clear and emphatic these signs are!
translations.idiomatic: How clear and emphatic these signs are!

sentences.zh: 上瞻俯察，朕實懼焉。

translations.literal: Looking up and looking down, I am truly afraid.
translations.idiomatic: Looking up and looking down, I am truly afraid.

sentences.zh: 將避正寢，齋居克念，惡衣減膳，去飾撤懸，披不諱之誠，開直言之路。

translations.literal: I shall leave the principal chamber, dwell in seclusion with disciplined thought, wear coarse clothes and reduce my meals, remove adornments and take down bells and chimes, show unreserved sincerity, and open a path for frank speech.
translations.idiomatic: I shall leave the principal chamber, dwell in seclusion with disciplined thought, wear coarse clothes and reduce my meals, remove adornments and take down bells and chimes, show unreserved sincerity, and open a path for frank speech.

sentences.zh: 欲使刑不濫及，賞弗踰等，選舉以才，宮闈修德。

translations.literal: I wish to ensure punishments do not spread indiscriminately, rewards do not exceed merit, selection be by talent, and the inner palace cultivate virtue.
translations.idiomatic: I wish to ensure punishments do not spread indiscriminately, rewards do not exceed merit, selection be by talent, and the inner palace cultivate virtue.

sentences.zh: 宜宣諸內外，庶盡弼諧，允協民心，用消天譴。

translations.literal: This should be proclaimed within and without, so that all may assist in harmony, accord with the people's hearts, and dispel Heaven's reproof.
translations.idiomatic: This should be proclaimed within and without, so that all may assist in harmony, accord with the people's hearts, and dispel Heaven's reproof.

sentences.zh: 於是舍仗衛，往天興宮。

translations.literal: Thereupon he set aside his guards and went to the Tianxing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he set aside his guards and went to the Tianxing Palace.

sentences.zh: 百官上表勸復寢膳，許之。

translations.literal: The hundred officials submitted memorials urging him to resume normal residence and meals, and he assented.
translations.idiomatic: The hundred officials submitted memorials urging him to resume normal residence and meals, and he assented.

sentences.zh: 甲子，還宮。

translations.literal: On jiazi day he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 御正武殿，集百官及宮人內外命婦，大列妓樂，又縱胡人乞寒，用水澆沃為戲樂。

translations.literal: He sat at the Hall of Correct Martialness, gathered the hundred officials, inner-palace women, and wives of officials inside and out, arrayed a great display of singing girls and musicians, and also allowed foreigners to perform the begging-for-cold rite, splashing one another with water for amusement.
translations.idiomatic: He sat at the Hall of Correct Martialness, gathered the hundred officials, inner-palace women, and wives of officials inside and out, arrayed a great display of singing girls and musicians, and also allowed foreigners to perform the begging-for-cold rite, splashing one another with water for amusement.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，行幸洛陽。

translations.literal: On yichou day he traveled to Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day he traveled to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 帝親御驛馬，日行三百里。

translations.literal: The emperor himself rode relay horses, traveling three hundred li a day.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor himself rode relay horses, traveling three hundred li a day.

sentences.zh: 四皇后及文武侍衛數百人，並乘驛以從。

translations.literal: The four empresses and several hundred civil and military attendants all rode relays to follow.
translations.idiomatic: The four empresses and several hundred civil and military attendants all rode relays to follow.

sentences.zh: 仍令四後方駕齊驅，或有先後，便加譴責，人馬頓僕相屬。

translations.literal: He ordered the four empresses' chariots to drive abreast; if any fell ahead or behind he at once reprimanded them, and men and horses collapsed one after another in exhaustion.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the four empresses' chariots to drive abreast; if any fell ahead or behind he at once reprimanded them, and men and horses collapsed one after another in exhaustion.

sentences.zh: 己卯，還宮。

translations.literal: On jimao day he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月丁亥，帝受朝于道會苑。

translations.literal: Second year, first month of spring, on dinghai day the emperor received court at Dao Assembly Park.
translations.idiomatic: Second year, first month of spring, on dinghai day the emperor received court at Dao Assembly Park.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，祀太廟，乙巳，造二扆，畫日月之象，以置左右。

translations.literal: On guisi day he sacrificed at the Imperial Ancestors' Temple; on yisi day two screens were made, painted with images of the sun and moon, and placed to left and right.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day he sacrificed at the Imperial Ancestors' Temple; on yisi day two screens were made, painted with images of the sun and moon, and placed to left and right.

sentences.zh: 戊申，雨雪。

translations.literal: On wushen day there was snow and rain.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day there was snow and rain.

sentences.zh: 雪止，又雨細黃土，移時乃息。

translations.literal: When the snow stopped, fine yellow dust rained down and continued for some time before ceasing.
translations.idiomatic: When the snow stopped, fine yellow dust rained down and continued for some time before ceasing.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔江左諸州新附民，給復二十年，初稅入市者，人一錢。

translations.literal: On yimao day an edict granted newly submitted people of the Jiangzuo provinces twenty years' relief from levies and for the first time taxed market entrants one coin per person.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day an edict granted newly submitted people of the Jiangzuo provinces twenty years' relief from levies and for the first time taxed market entrants one coin per person.

sentences.zh: 二月丁巳，帝幸露門學，行釋奠之禮。

translations.literal: Second month, on dingsi day, the emperor visited Lumen Academy and performed the libation sacrifice to Confucius.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, on dingsi day, the emperor visited Lumen Academy and performed the libation sacrifice to Confucius.

sentences.zh: 戊午，突厥遣使獻方物，且逆千金公主。

translations.literal: On wuwu day the Turks sent envoys presenting local products and also escorting the Thousand Gold Princess.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day the Turks sent envoys presenting local products and also escorting the Thousand Gold Princess.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，改制詔為天制詔，敕為天敕。

translations.literal: On yichou day imperial edicts were renamed Heavenly Decrees and orders were renamed Heavenly Commands.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day imperial edicts were renamed Heavenly Decrees and orders were renamed Heavenly Commands.

sentences.zh: 壬午，尊天元皇太后為天元上皇太后，天皇太后李氏曰天元聖皇太后。

translations.literal: On renwu day the Heavenly Primordial Dowager Empress was honored as Supreme Heavenly Primordial Dowager Empress, and Grand Heavenly Dowager Empress Lady Li was styled Sacred Heavenly Primordial Dowager Empress.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day the Heavenly Primordial Dowager Empress was honored as Supreme Heavenly Primordial Dowager Empress, and Grand Heavenly Dowager Empress Lady Li was styled Sacred Heavenly Primordial Dowager Empress.

sentences.zh: 癸未，立天元皇后楊氏為天元大皇后，天皇後朱氏為天大皇后，天右皇后元氏為天右大皇后，天左皇后陳氏為天左大皇后。

translations.literal: On guiwei day Heavenly Primordial Empress Lady Yang was installed as Grand Heavenly Primordial Empress, Grand Heavenly Empress Zhu as Grand Heavenly Empress, Heavenly Right Empress Yuan as Grand Heavenly Right Empress, and Heavenly Left Empress Chen as Grand Heavenly Left Empress.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day Heavenly Primordial Empress Lady Yang was installed as Grand Heavenly Primordial Empress, Grand Heavenly Empress Zhu as Grand Heavenly Empress, Heavenly Right Empress Yuan as Grand Heavenly Right Empress, and Heavenly Left Empress Chen as Grand Heavenly Left Empress.

sentences.zh: 正陽宮皇后直稱皇后。

translations.literal: The empress of the Zhengyang Palace was simply styled Empress.
translations.idiomatic: The empress of the Zhengyang Palace was simply styled Empress.

sentences.zh: 是日，洛陽有禿鶖鳥集於新營太極殿前。

translations.literal: That day at Luoyang bald ibises gathered before the newly built Hall of Supreme Polarity.
translations.idiomatic: That day at Luoyang bald ibises gathered before the newly built Hall of Supreme Polarity.

sentences.zh: 滎州有黑龍見，與赤龍鬬於汴水之側，黑龍死。

translations.literal: At Ying Province a black dragon appeared and fought a red dragon beside the Bian River; the black dragon died.
translations.idiomatic: At Ying Province a black dragon appeared and fought a red dragon beside the Bian River; the black dragon died.

sentences.zh: 三月丁亥，賜百官及民大酺。

translations.literal: Third month, on dinghai day, a great communal feast was granted to officials and the people.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, on dinghai day, a great communal feast was granted to officials and the people.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「盛德之後，是稱不絕，功施於民，義昭祀典。

translations.literal: An edict declared: "The line of a sage of flourishing virtue is said never to perish; merit shown to the people deserves clear place in the sacrificial canon.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "The line of a sage of flourishing virtue is said never to perish; merit shown to the people deserves clear place in the sacrificial canon.

sentences.zh: 孔子德惟藏往，道實生知，以大聖之才，屬千古之運，載弘儒業，式敘彝倫。

translations.literal: Confucius stored past virtue and embodied innate wisdom; with the talent of a great sage he belonged to the fortune of a thousand ages, broadly carried forward Confucian learning and set in order human relations.
translations.idiomatic: Confucius stored past virtue and embodied innate wisdom; with the talent of a great sage he belonged to the fortune of a thousand ages, broadly carried forward Confucian learning and set in order human relations.

sentences.zh: 至如幽贊天人之理，裁成禮樂之務，故以作范百王，垂風萬葉。

translations.literal: As for silently aiding the principle of Heaven and man and completing the work of rites and music, thus he became the model for a hundred kings and his influence extends through ten thousand generations.
translations.idiomatic: As for silently aiding the principle of Heaven and man and completing the work of rites and music, thus he became the model for a hundred kings and his influence extends through ten thousand generations.

sentences.zh: 朕欽承寶曆，服膺教義，眷言洙、泗，懷道滋深。

translations.literal: I reverently receive the precious succession and keep the teaching close to heart; speaking of Zhu and Si, my regard for the Way grows deeper.
translations.idiomatic: I reverently receive the precious succession and keep the teaching close to heart; speaking of Zhu and Si, my regard for the Way grows deeper.

sentences.zh: 且褒成啟號，雖彰故實，旌崇聖績，猶有闕如。

translations.literal: Though the enfeoffment at Baocheng restored the old title, the honoring of sacred merit still falls short.
translations.idiomatic: Though the enfeoffment at Baocheng restored the old title, the honoring of sacred merit still falls short.

sentences.zh: 可追封為鄒國公，邑數准舊。

translations.literal: He may be posthumously enfeoffed as Duke of Zou, with a fief commensurate with the old standard.
translations.idiomatic: He may be posthumously enfeoffed as Duke of Zou, with a fief commensurate with the old standard.

sentences.zh: 並立後承襲。

translations.literal: A descendant shall be installed to receive succession in perpetuity.
translations.idiomatic: A descendant shall be installed to receive succession in perpetuity.

sentences.zh: 別於京師置廟，以時祭享。

translations.literal: A separate temple shall be established in the capital and sacrifices offered at the proper seasons.
translations.idiomatic: A separate temple shall be established in the capital and sacrifices offered at the proper seasons.

sentences.zh: 」戊子，行軍總管、杞國公亮舉兵反，襲行軍元帥、鄖國公韋孝寬於豫州。

translations.literal: " On wuzi day campaigning commander-in-chief Duke of Qi Yu Liang raised troops in rebellion and attacked campaigning marshal Wei Xiaokuan, Duke of Yun, at Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: " On wuzi day Yu Liang, Duke of Qi and campaigning commander-in-chief, raised troops in rebellion and attacked campaigning marshal Wei Xiaokuan, Duke of Yun, at Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 亮不勝，孝寬獲而殺之。

translations.literal: Liang did not prevail; Xiaokuan captured and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Liang did not prevail; Xiaokuan captured and killed him.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以永昌公椿為杞國公，紹簡公連後。

translations.literal: On xinmao day Duke of Yongchang Chun was made Duke of Qi to continue the line of Duke of Jian Lian.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Duke of Yongchang Chun was made Duke of Qi to continue the line of Duke of Jian Lian.

sentences.zh: 行幸同州。

translations.literal: He traveled to Tong Province.
translations.idiomatic: He traveled to Tong Province.

sentences.zh: 增候正，前驅戒道，為三百六十重，自應門至於赤岸澤，數十里間，幡旗相蔽，鼓樂俱作。

translations.literal: The number of advance scouts was increased, and outriders cleared the road in three hundred and sixty ranks; from the Responding Gate to Red Bank Marsh, over several tens of li, banners hid one another and drums and music sounded together.
translations.idiomatic: The number of advance scouts was increased, and outriders cleared the road in three hundred and sixty ranks; from the Responding Gate to Red Bank Marsh, over several tens of li, banners hid one another and drums and music sounded together.

sentences.zh: 又令武賁持鈒馬上，稱警蹕，以至於同州。

translations.literal: He also ordered armored guards to carry halberds on horseback and call out the imperial progress, all the way to Tong Province.
translations.idiomatic: He also ordered armored guards to carry halberds on horseback and call out the imperial progress, all the way to Tong Province.

sentences.zh: 乙未，改同州宮為天成宮。

translations.literal: On yiwei day the Tong Province palace was renamed Tiancheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day the Tong Province palace was renamed Tiancheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚子，至自同州。

translations.literal: On gengzi day he returned from Tong Province.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day he returned from Tong Province.

sentences.zh: 詔天臺侍衛之官，皆著五色及紅紫綠衣，以雜色為緣，名曰品色衣。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that officials of the Heavenly Terrace guard all wear five-colored and red, purple, and green garments, with mixed colors as trim, called graded-color robes.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that officials of the Heavenly Terrace guard all wear five-colored and red, purple, and green garments, with mixed colors as trim, called graded-color robes.

sentences.zh: 有大事，與公服間服之。

translations.literal: On great occasions they were worn alternately with formal and semi-formal court dress.
translations.idiomatic: On great occasions they were worn alternately with formal and semi-formal court dress.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔內外命婦皆執笏，其拜宗廟及天臺，皆俛伏。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that all wives of officials inside and out carry tablets; in bowing at the Imperial Ancestors' Temple and the Heavenly Terrace they all prostrated themselves.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that all wives of officials inside and out carry tablets; in bowing at the Imperial Ancestors' Temple and the Heavenly Terrace they all prostrated themselves.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，初置天中大皇后。

translations.literal: The Heavenly Central Grand Empress was first established.
translations.idiomatic: The Heavenly Central Grand Empress was first established.

sentences.zh: 立天左大皇后陳氏為天中大皇后，立妃尉遲氏為天左大皇后。

translations.literal: Grand Heavenly Left Empress Chen was installed as Heavenly Central Grand Empress, and Consort Yuchi was installed as Grand Heavenly Left Empress.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Heavenly Left Empress Chen was installed as Heavenly Central Grand Empress, and Consort Yuchi was installed as Grand Heavenly Left Empress.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙丑，有星大如斗，出天廚，流入紫宮，抵鉤陳乃滅。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on yichou day, a star as large as a dipper emerged from the Celestial Kitchen, flowed into the Purple Palace, reached the Hooked Array, and vanished.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, on yichou day, a star as large as a dipper emerged from the Celestial Kitchen, flowed into the Purple Palace, reached the Hooked Array, and vanished.

sentences.zh: 己巳，祀太廟。

translations.literal: On jisi day sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestors' Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day he sacrificed at the Imperial Ancestors' Temple.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔曰：「朕以寡薄，昧於治方，不能使天地休和，陰陽調序。

translations.literal: An edict declared: "I am of meager endowment and ignorant of the way to govern; I cannot make Heaven and earth harmonious or yin and yang properly ordered.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "I am of meager endowment and ignorant of the way to govern; I cannot make Heaven and earth harmonious or yin and yang properly ordered.

sentences.zh: 自春涉夏，甘澤未豐，旣軫西郊之歎，將虧南畝之業。

translations.literal: From spring through summer sweet rain has not been abundant; I already grieve for the western suburbs, and the southern fields' work is about to suffer loss.
translations.idiomatic: From spring through summer sweet rain has not been abundant; I already grieve for the western suburbs, and the southern fields' work is about to suffer loss.

sentences.zh: 興言夕惕，無忘鑒昧。

translations.literal: Reflecting at night with vigilance, I do not forget this warning from darkness.
translations.idiomatic: Reflecting at night with vigilance, I do not forget this warning from darkness.

sentences.zh: 良由德化未敷，政刑多舛，萬方有罪，責在朕躬。

translations.literal: Truly it is because virtue and transformation have not spread and government and punishments have often gone wrong; if the myriad regions have guilt, the blame lies on my person.
translations.idiomatic: Truly it is because virtue and transformation have not spread and government and punishments have often gone wrong; if the myriad regions have guilt, the blame lies on my person.

sentences.zh: 思覃寬惠，被之率土。

translations.literal: I think to extend broad kindness and spread it over all the land.
translations.idiomatic: I think to extend broad kindness and spread it over all the land.

sentences.zh: 見囚死罪竝降從流，流罪從徒，五歲刑已下悉皆原宥。

translations.literal: All prisoners facing death shall have their sentences reduced one degree to exile; exile shall become penal servitude; punishments of five years and below shall all be pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: All prisoners facing death shall have their sentences reduced one degree to exile; exile shall become penal servitude; punishments of five years and below shall all be pardoned.

sentences.zh: 其反叛惡逆不道，及常赦所不免者，不在降例。

translations.literal: Those guilty of rebellion, wickedness, and inhumanity, and those whom regular amnesties cannot exempt, are not within the scope of reduction.
translations.idiomatic: Those guilty of rebellion, wickedness, and inhumanity, and those whom regular amnesties cannot exempt, are not within the scope of reduction.

sentences.zh: 」壬午，幸

translations.literal: " On renwu day he visited
translations.idiomatic: " On renwu day he visited

translations.literal: (Zhong)
translations.idiomatic: (Zhong)

sentences.zh: 〔仲〕山祈雨。

translations.literal: Mountain to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: Mountain to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 至咸陽宮，雨降。

translations.literal: When he reached Xianyang Palace, rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: When he reached Xianyang Palace, rain fell.

sentences.zh: 甲申，還宮。

translations.literal: On jiashen day he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 令京城士女於衢巷作音樂以迎候。

translations.literal: He ordered the gentry and women of the capital to perform music in the streets to welcome him.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the gentry and women of the capital to perform music in the streets to welcome him.

sentences.zh: 五月己丑，以上柱國、大前疑、隨國公楊堅為揚州總管。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on jichou day, Grand Pillar-of-State, Grand Front Advisor Yang Jian, Duke of Sui, was made governor-general of Yang Province.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, on jichou day, Grand Pillar-of-State and Grand Front Advisor Yang Jian, Duke of Sui, was made governor-general of Yang Province.

sentences.zh: 甲午夜，帝備法駕幸天興宮。

translations.literal: At midnight on jiazi day the emperor prepared the full imperial procession and visited the Tianxing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: At midnight on jiazi day the emperor prepared the full imperial procession and visited the Tianxing Palace.

sentences.zh: 乙未，帝不豫，還宮。

translations.literal: On yiwei day the emperor fell ill and returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day the emperor fell ill and returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 詔隨國公堅入侍疾。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Duke of Sui Jian to enter and attend his illness.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Yang Jian, Duke of Sui, to enter and attend his illness.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，有星大如三斗，出太微端門，流入翼，聲若風鼓幡旗。

translations.literal: On jiachen day a star as large as three dippers emerged from the End Gate of Supreme Palace Enclosure, flowed into the Wings, and sounded like wind beating banners and drums.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day a star as large as three dippers emerged from the End Gate of Supreme Palace Enclosure, flowed into the Wings, and sounded like wind beating banners and drums.

sentences.zh: 丁未，追趙、陳、越、代、滕五王入朝。

translations.literal: On dingwei day the princes of Zhao, Chen, Yue, Dai, and Teng were summoned to court.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day the princes of Zhao, Chen, Yue, Dai, and Teng were summoned to court.

sentences.zh: 己酉，大漸。

translations.literal: On jiyou day his illness became extreme.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day his illness became extreme.

sentences.zh: 御正下大夫劉昉，與內史上大夫鄭譯矯制，以隨國公堅受遺輔政。

translations.literal: Director of Correctness Subordinate Grandee Liu Fang and Inner Scribe Senior Grandee Zheng Yi forged an edict appointing Duke of Sui Jian to receive the testamentary charge and assist in government.
translations.idiomatic: Director of Correctness Subordinate Grandee Liu Fang and Inner Scribe Senior Grandee Zheng Yi forged an edict appointing Yang Jian, Duke of Sui, to receive the testamentary charge and assist in government.

sentences.zh: 是日，帝崩於天德殿。

translations.literal: That day the emperor died in the Tiande Hall.
translations.idiomatic: That day Emperor Xuan died in the Tiande Hall.

sentences.zh: 時年二十二，諡曰宣皇帝。

translations.literal: He was then twenty-two years old; his posthumous title was Emperor Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: He was then twenty-two years old; his posthumous title was Emperor Xuan.

sentences.zh: 七月丙申，葬定陵。

translations.literal: Seventh month, on bingshen day, he was buried at Dingling.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, on bingshen day, he was buried at Dingling.

sentences.zh: 帝之在東宮也，高祖慮其不堪承嗣，遇之甚嚴。

translations.literal: When the emperor was in the Eastern Palace, High Ancestor feared he could not bear the succession and treated him with great severity.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xuan was in the Eastern Palace, High Ancestor feared he could not bear the succession and treated him with great severity.

sentences.zh: 朝見進止，與諸臣無異，雖隆寒盛暑，亦不得休息。

translations.literal: In attending court and in advancing or withdrawing he was no different from the other ministers; even in deep cold or blazing heat he was not allowed rest.
translations.idiomatic: In attending court and in advancing or withdrawing he was no different from the other ministers; even in deep cold or blazing heat he was not allowed rest.

sentences.zh: 性旣嗜酒，高祖遂禁醪醴不許至東宮。

translations.literal: His nature being fond of wine, High Ancestor therefore forbade ale and sweet wine from reaching the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: His nature being fond of wine, High Ancestor therefore forbade ale and sweet wine from reaching the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 帝每有過，輒加捶撲。

translations.literal: Whenever the emperor had faults, blows were at once added.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever Emperor Xuan had faults, blows were at once added.

sentences.zh: 嘗謂之曰：「古來太子被廢者幾人，餘兒豈不堪立耶。

translations.literal: High Ancestor once said to him: "Through the ages, how many crown princes have been deposed? Are my other sons unfit to be installed?"
translations.idiomatic: High Ancestor once said to him: "Through the ages, how many crown princes have been deposed? Are my other sons unfit to be installed?"

sentences.zh: 」於是遣東宮官屬錄帝言語動作，每月奏聞。

translations.literal: Thereupon Eastern Palace officials and staff were sent to record the emperor's words and actions and report them monthly.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Eastern Palace officials and staff were sent to record Emperor Xuan's words and actions and report them monthly.

sentences.zh: 帝憚高祖威嚴，矯情修飾，以是過惡遂不外聞。

translations.literal: The emperor feared High Ancestor's majesty, feigned feeling and adorned himself, and so his faults and wickedness did not reach the outside.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuan feared High Ancestor's majesty, feigned feeling and adorned himself, and so his faults and wickedness did not reach the outside.

sentences.zh: 嗣位之初，方逞其欲。

translations.literal: At the beginning of his succession he at once gave free rein to his desires.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of his succession he at once gave free rein to his desires.

sentences.zh: 大行在殯，曾無戚容，卽閱視先帝宮人，逼為淫亂。

translations.literal: While the late emperor lay in the coffin he showed not the least grief; he at once inspected the late emperor's palace women and forced them into licentious disorder.
translations.idiomatic: While the late emperor lay in the coffin he showed not the least grief; he at once inspected the late emperor's palace women and forced them into licentious disorder.

sentences.zh: 纔及踰年，便恣聲樂，采擇天下子女，以充後宮。

translations.literal: Hardly more than a year had passed before he indulged freely in music and song and selected daughters from throughout the realm to fill the inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: Hardly more than a year had passed before he indulged freely in music and song and selected daughters from throughout the realm to fill the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 好自矜誇，飾非拒諫。

translations.literal: He loved to boast of himself and cover faults while rejecting remonstrance.
translations.idiomatic: He loved to boast of himself and cover faults while rejecting remonstrance.

sentences.zh: 禪位之後，彌復驕奢，耽酗於後宮，或旬日不出。

translations.literal: After abdicating the throne he became even more arrogant and extravagant, drowning himself in drink in the inner palace, sometimes not emerging for ten days at a stretch.
translations.idiomatic: After abdicating the throne he became even more arrogant and extravagant, drowning himself in drink in the inner palace, sometimes not emerging for ten days at a stretch.

sentences.zh: 公卿近臣請事者，皆附奄官奏之。

translations.literal: When close ministers and high officials came to request business, all submitted through eunuch officials.
translations.idiomatic: When close ministers and high officials came to request business, all submitted through eunuch officials.

sentences.zh: 所居宮殿，帷帳皆飾以金玉珠寶，光華炫耀，極麗窮奢。

translations.literal: The halls where he dwelt and their curtains and canopies were all adorned with gold, jade, and jewels, dazzling in brilliance, reaching the utmost splendor and extravagance.
translations.idiomatic: The halls where he dwelt and their curtains and canopies were all adorned with gold, jade, and jewels, dazzling in brilliance, reaching the utmost splendor and extravagance.

sentences.zh: 及營洛陽宮，雖未成畢，其規模壯麗，踰於漢魏遠矣。

translations.literal: When the Luoyang palace was built, though it was not yet finished, its scale and magnificence far surpassed Han and Wei.
translations.idiomatic: When the Luoyang palace was built, though it was not yet finished, its scale and magnificence far surpassed Han and Wei.

sentences.zh: 唯自尊崇，無所顧憚。

translations.literal: He honored himself alone and feared nothing.
translations.idiomatic: He honored himself alone and feared nothing.

sentences.zh: 國典朝儀，率情變改。

translations.literal: State institutions and court ritual he altered according to whim.
translations.idiomatic: State institutions and court ritual he altered according to whim.

sentences.zh: 後宮位號，莫能詳錄。

translations.literal: The titles and ranks of the inner palace cannot be fully recorded.
translations.idiomatic: The titles and ranks of the inner palace cannot be fully recorded.

sentences.zh: 每對臣下，自稱為天。

translations.literal: Whenever he faced his ministers he called himself Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever he faced his ministers he called himself Heaven.

sentences.zh: 以五色土塗所御天德殿，各隨方色。

translations.literal: He had the five-colored earths smeared on the Tiande Hall where he sat, each according to its directional color.
translations.idiomatic: He had the five-colored earths smeared on the Tiande Hall where he sat, each according to its directional color.

sentences.zh: 又於後宮與皇后等列坐，用宗廟禮器樽彝珪瓚之屬以飲食焉。

translations.literal: He also in the inner palace sat in a row with the empresses and others, using ancestral temple ritual vessels such as goblets, libation cups, and jade scepters for eating and drinking.
translations.idiomatic: He also in the inner palace sat in a row with the empresses and others, using ancestral temple ritual vessels such as goblets, libation cups, and jade scepters for eating and drinking.

sentences.zh: 又令羣臣朝天臺者，皆致齋三日，清身一日。

translations.literal: He also ordered that all who attended court at the Heavenly Terrace observe fasting for three days and purify the body for one day.
translations.idiomatic: He also ordered that all who attended court at the Heavenly Terrace observe fasting for three days and purify the body for one day.

sentences.zh: 車旗章服，倍於前王之數。

translations.literal: Carriages, banners, seals, and robes were double the number of former kings.
translations.idiomatic: Carriages, banners, seals, and robes were double the number of former kings.

sentences.zh: 旣自比上帝，不欲令人同己。

translations.literal: Since he compared himself to the Supreme God, he did not wish others to be like himself.
translations.idiomatic: Since he compared himself to the Supreme God, he did not wish others to be like himself.
